title: run-record
description: One closed-task run-record. The fields are the observability standard (framework/doctrine/standards/observability.md); the store and the log path are instance-owned. Append-only NDJSON, one object per line, redacted before write.

ts.description: When this run closed (ISO 8601, injected from the runtime clock).

task_id.description: The ledger task id this run was.

slice.description: The slice of that task this run covered.

model.description: Opaque instance model/tier label — the framework never enumerates model names.

attempts.description: How many implement→verify iterations the run took.

cost.description: What the run spent, in the instance's unit.

first_pass.description: Did Verify pass on the first attempt?

gate_decisions.description: Redacted gate trail — records THAT a gate decided, never the payload it decided on.

reason_hash.description: sha256/12 of the reason — correlates identical reasons, reveals nothing.

metadata.description: Instance escape hatch for extra structured fields. Must carry no secrets (data-handling.md).
